title: Building blocks shared by all files

id.description: A short code for this item. Use only small letters, digits and dashes, no spaces. Example: data-science

text.description: Text that people read. Write it once per language, using the two-letter language code. Example: { "en": "Databases", "el": "Βάσεις Δεδομένων" }. One language is enough.

date.description: A date written as year-month-day. Example: 2026-10-05

academic_year.description: Two years joined by a dash. Example: 2026-2027

url.description: A web address starting with https://

ects.description: Number of ECTS credits (a number such as 6 or 7.5)
